# Fintech Entry, Lending Market Competition, and Welfare

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Zhiqiang Ye, Xavier Vives  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Journal of Financial Economics  
**DOI:** [10.1016/j.jfinec.2025.105234](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfinec.2025.105234)

**Keywords:** fintech, lending, competition, welfare, financial inclusion

## Abstract

This paper examines how fintech entry affects lending market competition and overall welfare, demonstrating that fintech entrants can enhance competition and improve welfare for borrowers.
